Peer Assessment Rubric

  • Leipzig Glossing Rule Precision (4 pts): The four-line gloss strictly adheres to Leipzig conventions (hyphens for morpheme boundaries, periods for multi-word glosses, standardized capital abbreviations for grammatical categories).
  • TEI Stand-Off Linkage Integrity (3 pts): The <linkGrp> element is properly structured and all @target URI pointers resolve cleanly to valid sentence IDs in the text body.
  • Syntactic Analysis & Non-Isomorphism (3 pts): The 300–500 word reflection insightfully analyzes grammatical asymmetries and why literal word-for-word alignment breaks down across differing linguistic typologies.
